Received

That's landed. Thank you.

Your enquiry is in the studio inbox. You'll hear back from a real person — usually Nishchay — within two business days.

  1. Check your inbox (and your spam folder)

    A confirmation is on its way to the address you gave us. If it isn't there in ten minutes, it's in spam — marking it as safe means our real reply reaches you too.

  2. We check the date and write back properly

    You'll get availability, a starting investment, and which collection we'd suggest for the day you described. Not a brochure.

  3. If it feels right, we talk

    A 30-minute call or a coffee at the Liberty Village studio. No pitch — we just want to know whether we're the right studio for your day.
